plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: 1. An instrument that checks each case's category against the requester's rule. Without one, C3 cannot be shown. 2. A way to put 'scope of a call' (C5) and 'trace of a call' (C10) in the plan. They work only on named lines of the record, so they must come from the allowance of 50, at 10 per line. That covers at most five lines in total, so C5 can be checked only on a sample of the 101 reads, and C10 only on a few sending calls, at best the ones not confirmed. 3. An answer that pairs each customer with its one case and one updated account (C2), instead of counts alone. 4. A check that reads the live tables after the promotion. same set and summary of the change read only the staged set as it was kept. 5. An outbox check that says it holds every action. Without that, a trace that is not found cannot settle that a notice was not sent.
